description:
Developed augmented reality (AR) interactive maps for a national competition (Teknofest 2023 Ankara Finalist) using Unity, Godot, and specialized AR SDKs.
Designed high-performance spatial mapping algorithms to coordinate 3D asset rendering with geographic coordinate systems.
Achieved finalist standing in the competition category through robust software architecture and interactive UI designs.
